title: Nazi expeditions searching for Atlantis

tellings.quote: They were they were going through Peru and Nepal and Tibet. There's photos of them with like, you know, these like high llamas and there like swastikas in the background.

plain: In the 1930s and 40s the Nazi SS is said to have sent expeditions through Peru, Nepal and Tibet looking for traces of Atlantis, the lost land of Plato's story. A guest named Jay Anderson tells Michels this without naming a source, adding that there are photos of the expedition members with high lamas, with swastikas in the background.
